failed_attempt.error: sft/firr18_v5 does not have its frozen 48-sample arm budget
failed_attempt.cause: The initial outcome-independent family hash selected firr18_v5, for which SFT, RF seed 1, and RF seed 2 each had zero oracle-correct candidates.

amendment.reason: A paired board experiment cannot instantiate an arm with no functional candidate.
amendment.eligibility: Require at least one oracle-correct candidate in SFT and at least one across the pooled two-seed RF arm, then apply the original family hash rule.
amendment.scientific_status: Transparent post-failure feasibility amendment. Any resulting silicon comparison is descriptive support and is not independent confirmatory evidence.
